topTool.defaultPrompt: Use the uploaded portrait as the identity reference. Transform the person into a natural young-adult version in their 20s. Preserve the same recognizable face, expression, pose, clothing, body, camera angle, lighting, and background. Make every visible detail age-consistent: firm youthful skin with an even natural complexion, full facial volume, a healthy hairline and hair density, bright but realistic eyes, and smooth natural skin on the face, neck, and hands. Remove only age-related cues that do not fit this stage, while keeping pores, texture, and character so the result never looks airbrushed or like a beauty filter.

presets.label: Bebé
presets.prompt: Use the uploaded portrait as the identity reference. Transform the person into a fictional baby-style version around 1–2 years old. Preserve recognizable identity cues such as eye shape, eye color, nose shape, expression, camera angle, lighting, and background. Make every visible detail age-appropriate: rounder cheeks and softer facial contours, smooth even baby skin, sparse fine hair, a small jaw and neck, and child-like hands and body proportions where visible. Adapt visible clothing into simple, fully clothed toddler clothing that keeps the original color palette. Keep the result photorealistic and safe; do not add extra people, text, logos, or watermarks.

presets.label: Niño
presets.prompt: Use the uploaded portrait as the identity reference. Transform the person into a fictional child version around 8–10 years old. Preserve recognizable identity cues such as eye shape, eye color, nose shape, expression, camera angle, lighting, and background. Make every visible detail age-appropriate: child-sized facial proportions, smooth skin, soft cheeks, a smaller jaw and neck, natural child hair density, and child-like hands and body scale where visible. Adapt visible clothing into simple, fully clothed age-appropriate clothing while keeping the original color palette. Keep the result photorealistic and safe; do not add extra people, text, logos, or watermarks.

presets.label: Adulto joven
presets.prompt: Use the uploaded portrait as the identity reference. Transform the person into a natural young-adult version in their 20s. Preserve the same recognizable face, expression, pose, clothing, body, camera angle, lighting, and background. Make every visible detail age-consistent: firm youthful skin with an even natural complexion, full facial volume, a healthy hairline and hair density, bright but realistic eyes, and smooth natural skin on the face, neck, and hands. Remove only age-related cues that do not fit this stage, while keeping pores, texture, and character so the result never looks airbrushed or like a beauty filter.

presets.label: Mediana edad
presets.prompt: Use the uploaded portrait as the identity reference. Transform the person into a natural middle-aged adult version around 45–55 years old. Preserve the same recognizable face, expression, pose, clothing, body, camera angle, lighting, and background. Make every visible detail age-consistent: subtle volume loss, realistic fine lines around the eyes, forehead, and mouth, slightly less uniform skin texture, early gray strands at the temples, and gentle maturation of visible facial skin, neck, and hands. Keep the person healthy, confident, photorealistic, and recognizable; do not exaggerate wrinkles or add text, logos, or watermarks.

presets.label: Adulto mayor
presets.prompt: Use the uploaded portrait as the identity reference. Transform the person into a natural older-adult version in their late 70s. Preserve the same recognizable face, expression, pose, clothing, body, camera angle, lighting, and background. Age all visible skin consistently: add realistic fine lines and wrinkles around the eyes, forehead, mouth, and cheeks; natural age spots, enlarged pores, subtly reduced facial volume, and gentle skin laxity on the visible facial skin, neck, and hands. Add believable silver-gray hair. Keep the result healthy, respectful, photorealistic, and non-caricatured; do not change the person's identity or add text, logos, or watermarks.

intro.title: ¿Qué es un filtro de edad con IA?

content.title: Cambia la edad de todo el retrato
content.text: Un filtro de edad con IA transforma más que el color del pelo. Puede guiar cambios apropiados para la edad en la cara, el pelo, la piel, el cuello, las manos y la ropa visibles, manteniendo reconocibles a la persona y la composición.

content.title: No detecta ni predice la edad
content.text: El resultado es una transformación creativa de imagen, no una estimación de tu edad real, una evaluación médica ni una predicción de la apariencia futura.

faqTitle: Preguntas frecuentes sobre el filtro de edad con IA

faq.a: Puedes elegir Bebé, Niño, Adulto joven, Mediana edad o Adulto mayor.
No. El filtro de edad está diseñado para un retrato claro.
Sí. Después de elegir la etapa, usa el campo de ajuste para pedir canas naturales o un cambio más delicado.

faq.q: ¿El resultado conservará mi rostro y fondo?
faq.a: Los prompts piden conservar rasgos reconocibles, pose, ropa, iluminación y fondo, aunque el resultado puede variar según la foto original.

faq.q: ¿Por qué dos fotos producen resultados diferentes?
faq.a: La luz, la pose, cuánto pelo cubre la cara, la calidad y la visibilidad del rostro influyen en la transformación.

faq.q: ¿El resultado muestra mi apariencia real en el futuro?
faq.a: No. Es una transformación visual creativa, no una predicción ni una evaluación de edad.
